conflicts.description: Chenault's FY2021 row in the 2022 proxy prints Fees 97,500, Stock Awards 299,915 and Total 397,145. The components sum to 397,415. The raw HTML has 397,145 (checked), so this looks like a transposed-digit typo in the filing. The 299,915 stock figure matches the 2,238-RSU annual grant ($299,870) plus a small in-lieu rounding increment, and the 97,500 cash matches his FY2022 cash. So the components are probably right and the total is wrong. The row is recorded as printed, so verify shows a WARN for it. No later filing restates the FY2021 table.

open_questions: Joseph Gebbia has no Director Compensation row for FY2022, but his advisor agreement started 2022-08-23 (d163). Either he was still an employee through 2022 or his 2022 non-employee pay was left out. No filing gives his 2022 advisory fees or when his employment ended. His FY2023 all-other ($26,664) is exactly 8 months at $3,333/month, and FY2024-FY2025 show no advisory fees. No filing says when or whether the advisor agreement ended.
Belinda Johnson served until 2023-06-01, but her FY2023 row is all dashes (d164). The 2024 proxy does not say whether she waived or forfeited cash fees for January-May 2023.

Ahrendts's FY2023 cash ($124,623) is $24,623 above her FY2022 and FY2024 amounts ($100,000). The proxy gives no per-role breakdown. The board file shows she chaired the stakeholder committee from 2023-06-01 until Manyika took it over after joining 2023-09-07.

Manyika's FY2023 stock award is 214,521 in the table, while footnote (2) gives a $214,475 grant-date value for his 1,497-RSU grant (d161). The 2024 proxy does not give the usual rounding explanation for the $46 gap. Footnote (1) also says his 438 in-lieu RSUs were 'granted in May 2023', before his 2023-09-07 appointment.

coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from the IPO prospectus (424B4 2020-12-11, FY2019) and every definitive proxy filed since (DEF 14A 2021-04-30, 2022-04-22, 2023-04-21, 2024-04-19, 2025-04-25, 2026-04-24), one table per fiscal year FY2019-FY2025: 46 rows (5, 6, 7, 6, 8, 7, 7). Airbnb filed no proxy before listing in December 2020, and no 10-K/A in the period (EDGAR submissions feed, both pages). Also checked: the DEFA14As filed with each proxy (2021-2026), which are notices without a director table, and the 2024 PRE 14A, whose table is identical to the DEF 14A. The S-1 (2020-11-16) and S-1/As carry the prospectus FY2019 table and are not recorded. Employee directors (Chesky, Blecharczyk, and Gebbia while an executive officer through FY2022) get no board pay and have no rows (d132, d166). Three rows printed as all dashes are recorded as zeros: Jordan and Lin FY2019 (ineligible as nominee-employees of stockholders) and Johnson FY2023. Calendar fiscal year.
